comment: name represents name of the variant or name of the entity
texture - path to the main texture file
saddle - path to the saddle texture file
model - path to the model file, must be located in geo folder due to how Geckolib works
animation - path to the model file, must be located in animations folder due to how Geckolib works
Redirect declarations can be added under any namespace
Full path to redirect file would look something like this: assets/yournamespace/model_redirect/*dragon ID*.json
*dragon ID* represents path part in entity's ID. I.e. for Deadly Nadder dragon ID would be deadly_nadder, for Gronckle - gronckle. Exception is Monstrous Nightmare. It'll be just nightmare
You can use nametag_accessible field to prevent variant from being applicable via nametags. If not specified, by default variant can be applied via nametag
Comments do nothing btw, you can yeet them
